title: PS-3 acceptance criteria
feature_label: Terraform hosting stack (diff) - PR #21 diff (not deployed)

steps.label: Run `mise run infra:fmt` and `mise run infra:validate` and see both finish without errors.
Run `mise run infra:policies` and see every negative fixture rejected and `policies pass` for the real roots.
Open infra/modules/site-hosting/main.tf and confirm the bucket blocks public access and CloudFront has no logging, WAF or compute.
Open infra/modules/cost-guard and confirm a 2 USD monthly budget with notifications at 80% and 100% of actual spend.
Read docs/runbooks/hosting-first-apply.md and confirm it covers the first apply, the DNS cut-over and the rollback.
